text: StageMeter presence, settled with Studio on 2026-09-26. For study runs, every RunProgress event carries a StageMeter, so the meter is required. "Counting…" is expressed in StageMeter.total: SegmentTotal is Counting until the stage's exact total is known, then Exact(n). An absent meter is not used to mean counting. Option[StageMeter] survives only at the generic Submission level (meter: C => Option[StageMeter]) for cursors that have no stage vocabulary; the study cursor always returns Some. Studio's S3.0 protocol keeps the meter required and renders total = Counting as "counting…".
